text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: 4.6% of revenue · 39.67% gross margin · Strongest in the company

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: Megmeet claims the top share of China's robotic gas-shielded arc-welding power-source market for ten consecutive

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: years since 2014 and about 30% share in 2020-21 — company claims on the company's own site, not an audited ranking.

g.text: What is checkable is commercial: repeat framework deals with Honglu for 1,500 and then 1,800 robotic welding

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: machines, integration with FANUC, ABB and KUKA, exports to 60+ countries. Highest gross margin in the company at

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: 39.67% and rising.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: 30.4% of revenue · 25.06% gross margin · Real, growing, and unranked

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: The only mainland vendor NVIDIA named for GB200 NVL72 power and on both published rosters; the company's own H1 2026

g.text: wording is "one of NVIDIA's designated recommended data-centre power suppliers" — membership of a set, not a rank.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: +60.92% at the only expanding gross margin in the company. No AI-data-centre revenue line is disclosed at any

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: granularity.

g.text: Industrial automation

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: 7.4% of revenue · 27.78% gross margin · Credible, small, well behind the leader

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: +39.85% in FY2025, the second-highest margin pool in the company at 27.78%. The company's own scope statement leads

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: with servo and VFD drives, not PLC and HMI. The market is genuinely unconcentrated — across ten listed Chinese

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #23211c

g.text: players, CR3 is reported around 9% and CR10 around 12%.

g.text: 9.3% of revenue · 13.46% gross margin · Volume land-grab, margin-dilutive

g.text: Revenue doubled in FY2025 (+108.65%) at the lowest gross margin of the major segments; 13.46% in H1 2026. More than

g.text: a million combined OBC plus DC-DC units shipped in 2025. Named OEMs: Geely, BAIC New Energy, Leapmotor, Changan,

g.text: Dongfeng, FAW, Seres.

g.text: 42.2% of revenue · 18.39% gross margin · Biggest unit, weakest position, deteriorating

g.text: 42.19% of revenue at 18.39% gross margin, down about 4.2 points in a year. It was the only segment that shrank in

g.text: FY2025 (-4.8%). Named customers: Xiaomi, Haier, Hisense, Changhong, Skyworth. The smart-bathroom line is genuinely

g.text: distinctive rather than a controller commodity.

g.text: Magnetics and precision manufacturing

g.text: 5.0% of revenue · 8.79% gross margin · Vertical integration rather than a merchant business

g.text: 8.79% gross margin, up from 5.1% but still the lowest in the company. The company describes it as an

g.text: investment-and-integration period. Shaped magnet wire, coaxial cable, ultra-fine flat wire, FFC/FPC feeding internal

g.text: magnetics supply plus external sales.
